{{Short description|Annual association football award event in France}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2024}} {{Infobox award | name = 2016 Ballon d'Or | image = Euro 2016 Cristiano Ronaldo.jpg | caption = 2016 Ballon d'Or winner, Cristiano Ronaldo | date = {{start date|2016|12|12|df=y}} | location = [[Paris]], France | presenter = ''[[France Football]]'' | website = {{URL|ballondor.com}} | award1_type = Won by | award1_winner = {{flagicon|POR}} [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] (4th award) | previous = [[2015 FIFA Ballon d'Or|2015]] | main = [[Ballon d'Or]] | next = [[2017 Ballon d'Or|2017]] }} The '''2016 Ballon d'Or''' ({{lit|'''2016 Golden Ball'''}}), was an award given to the best-performing [[association football|football]] player around the world in 2016. In September 2016, ''[[France Football]]'' announced that their partnership with [[FIFA]] for the [[FIFA Ballon d'Or]] award had come to an end and that they would revive the [[Ballon d'Or]] award, treating the 2016 edition as the 61st award.{{cite web|url=http://www.francefootball.fr/news/Nouvelle-donne-pour-le-ballon-d-or/727802|title=Nouvelle donne pour le Ballon d'Or|publisher=France Football|language=fr|date=16 September 2016|access-date=16 September 2016|archive-date=19 September 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160919025954/http://www.francefootball.fr/news/Nouvelle-donne-pour-le-ballon-d-or/727802|url-status=live}} ''France Football'' announced that they would publish a shortlist of 30 players across six announcements with two hour intervals on 24 October 2016. On 12 December 2016, [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] won the award by a record margin of 429 points ahead of second placed [[Lionel Messi]] and [[Antoine Griezmann]], who came third.{{cite web|title=Ballon d'Or France Football 2016 : rendez-vous à partir de lundi matin à 8 heures sur FF.fr et dès mardi dans FF pour découvrir la liste des 30 nommés|url=http://www.francefootball.fr/news/Ballon-d-or-france-football-2016-rendez-vous-a-partir-de-lundi-matin-a-8-heures-sur-ff-fr-et-des-mardi-dans-ff-pour-decouvrir-la-liste-des-30-nommes/739770|publisher=France Football|access-date=24 October 2016|language=fr|date=24 October 2016|archive-date=24 October 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161024151752/http://www.francefootball.fr/news/Ballon-d-or-france-football-2016-rendez-vous-a-partir-de-lundi-matin-a-8-heures-sur-ff-fr-et-des-mardi-dans-ff-pour-decouvrir-la-liste-des-30-nommes/739770|url-status=live}}{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2016/dec/12/cristiano-ronaldo-ballon-dor-fourth-lionel-messi|title=Cristiano Ronaldo wins Ballon d'Or for the fourth time|date=12 December 2016|work=Guardian|access-date=13 December 2016|archive-date=13 December 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161213000238/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2016/dec/12/cristiano-ronaldo-ballon-dor-fourth-lionel-messi|url-status=live}} There were 173 voters. All were journalists, in a change from previous years, and each voter was from a different country.{{Cite news|url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/football/2016/12/12/ballon-dor-2016-results-final-rankings-cristiano-ronaldo-swoops/|title=Ballon d'Or 2016 results - the final rankings as Cristiano Ronaldo scoops award|newspaper=The Telegraph|date=12 December 2016|access-date=5 April 2018|archive-date=1 December 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211201212915/https://www.telegraph.co.uk/football/2016/12/12/ballon-dor-2016-results-final-rankings-cristiano-ronaldo-swoops/|url-status=live}} Each voter voted for three players who received 5 points, 3 points and one point respectively. Ronaldo scored 745 points out of a maximum possible of 865. It was his fourth [[Ballon d'Or]], the most of any European player in the history of the award. ==Rankings== Sources:{{cite
